svg.title: Proactive Runtime
svg.desc: A work example connects Codex dialogue, externally submitted Claude Code trajectories and screenshots to an Event Inbox. Built-in work observations collect new Codex user messages, final answers and screenshots every five minutes. Events are claimed oldest first and acknowledged after saving. The Agent waits between runs without continuous model calls. Each run reads task memory and any existing summaries for today and yesterday, reads original inputs, records only new facts or material changes, and searches related daily history at most five times. Summaries and retrieved history help avoid repeated reminders. An optional reminder contains one sentence without file paths; its evidence stays in the round record. The run merges today's records and generated reminders into today's summary, leaving it unchanged when there is nothing new. Five file cards show source manifests and payloads, task memory, both calendar summaries, daily records and optional reminders. Arrows show reads, writes and history lookup. Collector progress and unfinished delivery stay under their source roots and are not Agent inputs. Only committed reminders reach Chat Inbox as events pointing to saved reminder files. All messages are illustrative.
svg.metadata: Source: reme/config/proactive.yaml; reme/schema/application_config.py; reme/steps/proactive/data_connectors/base_connector.py; reme/steps/proactive/data_connectors/work_observation.py; reme/steps/proactive/data_connectors/_codex_dialogue.py; reme/steps/proactive/agent/proactive.py; reme/steps/proactive/agent/proactive.yaml; reme/components/agent_runtime/_internal/outbox.py; reme/components/agent_inbox/agent_event_inbox.py. Drawn from the current working tree. Claude Code is an illustrative external source. Paths use the defaults workspace_dir=.reme, resource_dir=resource, daily_dir=daily and reme_agent_dir=reme_agents; directory settings may be overridden. {today} and {yesterday} are application-local calendar dates; {batch} is HHMMSS_random6. Permanent work Agent shown. All events and decisions are illustrative.
svg.text: Claim a batch; acknowledge after saving.

g.text: Read today + yesterday · search daily history at most 5 times
Then merge today's records and reminders; keep the summary if unchanged.
Events pointing to saved reminder files

svg.text: Default paths: workspace_dir=.reme · resource_dir=resource · daily_dir=daily · reme_agent_dir=reme_agents. Directory settings may be overridden.
Work collector state: .reme/resource/codex_dialogue/progress.jsonl and .reme/resource/{source}/pending.json; source = screenshot or codex_dialogue.
